# UI component coverage matrix

Component + test inventory across `ui-headless` (behavior) and `ui-designsystem` (the shadcn
skin), and what's still missing versus real shadcn/ui.

**Generated by inspection on 2026-08-10** against the pinned reference
(`third_party/shadcn-ui-ref`, SHA `6261bd89…`, see `tools/fetch_shadcn_reference.sh`). Re-derive
with the greps at the bottom rather than editing counts by hand.

## Headline numbers

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Real shadcn/ui components (pinned ref, excl. infra/chat primitives) | 55 |
| Implemented in `ui-designsystem` | 41 (**74%**) |
| Missing entirely | 14 |
| `shadcn*` public entry points | 83 |
| `ui-headless` public entry points | 24 |
| Test files — designsystem / headless | 44 / 30 |

## Missing components (14)

None of these exist in `ui-designsystem` today:

| Component | Notes |
|---|---|
| `calendar` | Large: date grid, month nav, range selection. No headless date primitive either. |
| `command` | The cmdk palette. `shadcnCombobox` implements a *subset* (filter + list) inline. |
| `form` | React-Hook-Form binding in real shadcn — needs a rethink here, not a port. |
| `chart` | Recharts wrapper upstream; would be a from-scratch renderer here. |
| `carousel` | Embla wrapper upstream. |
| `menubar` | Desktop-style menu bar. |
| `navigation-menu` | |
| `pagination` | |
| `hover-card` | Close to `shadcnTooltip` + `shadcnPopover`; likely cheap. |
| `button-group` | Likely cheap — composition over `shadcnButton`. |
| `input-group` | Likely cheap — composition over `shadcnInput`. |
| `aspect-ratio` | Trivial layout primitive. |
| `native-select` | Platform `<select>`; may be intentionally N/A for a game engine. |
| `item` | Generic list-item primitive. |

Cheapest real wins: `aspect-ratio`, `button-group`, `input-group`, `hover-card`.

## Components with NO dedicated test file (15)

Present in `ui-designsystem` but with no `*Test.kt` naming them. Some are covered indirectly by
showcase//snapshot tests, so this is "no targeted test," not "wholly untested":

`Alert` · `AlertDialog` · `Collapsible` · `Field` · `Kbd` · `Label` · `Popover` · `Progress`
· `RadioGroup` · `Separator` · `Skeleton` · `Spinner` · `Switch` · `Textarea` · `Toast`

Highest-value gaps, given each owns real logic or was recently changed:
- **`Field`** — its gap values were all three wrong vs `gap-3`/`gap-6`/`gap-7` (fixed 2026-08-10); nothing guarded them.
- **`RadioGroup`** — same story (`gap-2` vs real `gap-3`).
- **`Collapsible`** — owns the trigger/`animatedHeight` shape now shared with `Accordion`.
- **`AlertDialog`** — default width was `max-w-xs` where real is `sm:max-w-lg`.

## Headless (`ui-headless`) entry points (24)

`avatarFallback` · `button` · `buttonSlot` · `checkbox` · `collapsible` · `contextMenuTrigger` ·
`drawDropdownTriggerContent` · `icon` · `progress` · `rangeSlider` · `resizablePanelGroup` ·
`select` · `separator` · `skeleton` · `slider` · `spinner` · `switch` · `text` · `textField` ·
`textarea` · `toast` · `toggle` · `toggleGroup` · `toggleSlot`

Behavior extracted here but *without* a headless-level primitive of its own (the designsystem
still owns composition): `menu`/`menuItem` (measurement only — `measureMenuItemLayout`),
`otp*` helpers, `filterOptionsByQuery`, `slideInPanelBounds`, `UiContextMenuTrigger`. These are
pure functions rather than widgets, which is the intended shape — see
`skills/awake-ui-authoring/SKILL.md`.

**Known gap:** there is no headless `tabs()`. `shadcnTabs` owns its own selection resolution and
content-hugging width measurement, so a differently-skinned tab strip can't reuse either.

## Verification gates in place

| Gate | What it actually proves |
|---|---|
| `ShadcnRadiusScaleTest` | `fromBase` follows Tailwind's multiplicative ladder (was additive, silently wrong for every non-Vega preset). |
| `ShadcnReferenceTokenTest` / `…ExpandedTest` | Color tokens vs published OKLCH values. |
| `ShadcnParityScreenshotTest` | Golden-image lock; re-record with `-DAWAKE_RECORD_SNAPSHOTS=true`. |
| `ShadcnReferenceComparisonTest` + `shadcn_parity_baseline.json` | **Regression only** — each number is a previously-*accepted* mismatch %, not a fidelity target. Currently accepts 28–44% on badge/button/card. |
| `UiShowcaseLayoutSignatureTest` | Whole-page semantic layout fingerprints. |
| `*FidelityTest` | Per-component exact dimension/spacing rules. |

**Caveat that limits all of the above:** fidelity tests construct `BitmapFont()`, while the app
runs `PackedUiFont(RobotoRegularUiFontData)`. The two disagree on `visibleTopEm`/`visibleBottomEm`
/`lineHeightEm`, which are exactly the inputs to vertical text centering — so text-alignment bugs
can pass every test and still ship. See `skills/awake-ui-shadcn-styling/SKILL.md`.

## Re-deriving these numbers

```bash
# designsystem entry points
grep -rho "^fun [A-Za-z]*Scope\?\.\?shadcn[A-Za-z]*" --include="*.kt" \
  awake/engine/ui/designsystem/src/commonMain/ | sed 's/^fun //; s/^.*\.//' | sort -u

# headless entry points
grep -rho "^fun [A-Za-z]*Scope\?\.\?[a-z][A-Za-z]*(" --include="*.kt" \
  awake/engine/ui/headless/src/commonMain/ | sed 's/^fun //; s/^.*\.//; s/($//' | sort -u

# real shadcn set (requires tools/fetch_shadcn_reference.sh first)
ls third_party/shadcn-ui-ref/apps/v4/registry/new-york-v4/ui/ | sed 's/\.tsx$//' | sort
```
